abstract: Transverse sternotomy was performed in a 39-year-old man having bilateral lung metastatic lesions of yolk sac tumor. This approach provided an excellent operative field. Bilateral partial lobes including parietal pleura and diaphragma were readily resected. As described in this paper, transverse sternotomy is one of the beneficial method in the thorough surgical treatment for metastatic bilateral lung lesion.
abstract_ja: 39歳の男性で両側肺の卵黄嚢腫瘍転移病変を認めた症例に対し、横断胸骨切開術を施行した。この方法により良好な術野が得られ、壁側胸膜および横隔膜を含む両側の部分肺葉を容易に切除できた。本報告で述べたように、横断胸骨切開術は両側性の転移性肺病変に対する徹底的な外科治療として有益な方法の一つである。
